prie.definition:
n. The plant privet.
v. i. To pry.
prie.translation: abbr. 催乳激素释放抑制因子

prie-dieu.definition: n low bench for kneeling on
prie-dieu.translation: n. 祈祷用矮台, 祈祷椅

pried.definition:
imp. & p. p. of Pry.
imp. & p. p. of Pry
pried.translation: v. 打听, 刺探（他人的私事）( pry的过去式和过去分词 ); 撬开

prier.definition:
n. One who pries; one who inquires narrowly and searches, or is
   inquisitive.
prier.translation: n. 刺探者, 窥探者

pries.definition:
n a heavy iron lever with one end forged into a wedge
v to move or force, especially in an effort to get something open
v be nosey
v search or inquire in a meddlesome way
v make an uninvited or presumptuous inquiry

priessnitz compress.translation: [医] 普里斯尼茨敷布(冷湿敷布)

priessnitz's bandage.translation: [医] 冷湿压绷带, 普里斯尼茨氏敷布(冷湿敷布)

priest.definition:
n. a clergyman in Christian churches who has the authority to perform or administer various religious rites; one of the Holy Orders
n. a person who performs religious duties and ceremonies in a non-Christian religion
priest.translation: n. 祭司, 牧师, 神父, 神质人员, 僧侣, 泰斗

priest-ridden.definition:
a. Controlled or oppressed by priests; as, a
   priest-ridden people.
priest-ridden.translation: a. 受神职人员压制的

priestcraft.definition:
n. a derogatory reference to priests who use their influence to control secular or political affairs
n. the skills involved in the work of a priest
priestcraft.translation: n. 祭司的本领, 神职人员对世俗权力的使用

priestess.translation: n. 女神职人员, 女祭司

priestesses.translation: n. （基督教以外某些宗教中的）女神职人员( priestess的复数形式 )

priesthood.definition: n. the body of ordained religious practitioners
priesthood.translation: n. 神职人员, 祭司职

priesthoods.definition:
plural of priesthood
n. the body of ordained religious practitioners
priesthoods.translation: (priesthood 的复数) n. 神职人员, 祭司职

priesting.definition: n. The office of a priest.
priesting.translation:
n. 牧师；神父；教士
vt. 使成为神职人员；任命…为祭司
n. (Priest)人名；(英、德)普里斯特

priestless.translation: a. 无祭司的, 无神职人员的

priestley.definition: n. English chemist who isolated many gases and discovered oxygen (independently of Scheele) (1733-1804)

priestley's mass.translation: [医] 普里斯特利氏物质(前牙上的绿色沉淀物)

priestlike.definition: a befitting or characteristic of a priest or the priesthood

priestliness.definition: n. The quality or state of being priestly.

priestling.translation: n. 小教士, 小和尚

priestly.definition:
a. associated with the priesthood or priests
a. befitting or characteristic of a priest or the priesthood

priests.definition:
n. a clergyman in Christian churches who has the authority to perform or administer various religious rites; one of the Holy Orders
n. a person who performs religious duties and ceremonies in a non-Christian religion
priests.translation: n. （基督教和罗马天主教的）神父( priest的复数形式 ); 牧师; （非基督教会的）教士; 祭司

prieta.translation: abbr. Agua Prieta (Spanish=Dark Water) （西班牙语）黑水（墨西哥边界城镇）
